about: Yasuo's heads are League's own (restyle_native.py votes them frame by frame, so they turn, bow and lie down with the body) with the design's face block pasted where native_pose.py tracks the face. Where that could not work these edits draw the face by hand: the bowed head of attack 2 and the dying ones of dead 2-4 get downcast eye lines, the lying dead 6-7 closed eyes, the profiles of q3 6-7 a mouth (and in q3 7, turned too far for the block, a brow and an eye) on the front edge. Idle's hair tie is the design's two squares (light over dark) in all six frames; League's tie came out as one or two gold squares or none, and flickered. import_native.py applies these edits after cutting the frames and stops if a pixel no longer has the colour an edit expects.
